verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a broad first-party API surface. The Manage Vanta API covers listing documents, policies, evidence and tests; creating, updating and deactivating controls; uploading and deleting contracts; assigning owners; and bulk offboarding. It is complemented by an Auditor API, Customer Trust questionnaire endpoints, webhooks and an MCP server that acts on compliance data. However, no source claims UI-to-API parity, and several UI product areas have no evidenced API coverage, and no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage for Trust Center, access reviews, risk register, TPRM and AI Agent workflows, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
